lines.text: Price-Claim Checker. Is that sale deal really a deal?
Sale posts promise big discounts against an MRP, and call it the lowest price. One product page can't tell you if that's true.
lines.say: Sale posts promise big discounts against an M R P, and call it the lowest price. One product page can't tell you if that's true.

lines.text: Under the hood, one check chains two SerpApi searches: Google Shopping for India, in rupees, then Google's product page for the matched item, which lists the same product at many stores. Fixed rules turn that into a verdict, with a receipt.
lines.say: Under the hood, one check chains two Serp A P I searches. Google Shopping for India, in rupees. Then Google's product page for the matched item, which lists the same product at many stores. Fixed rules turn that into a verdict, with a receipt.

lines.text: So paste the claim. This example, written for this demo, names one exact model; its name is hidden in this recording.
Fixed rules read the price, the discount, the MRP and the lowest-price promise. No AI model is involved, and every field can be corrected.
lines.say: Fixed rules read the price, the discount, the M R P, and the lowest price promise. No AI model is involved, and every field can be corrected.

lines.text: Check it. These are real searches, recorded on 8 October and replayed here.
lines.say: Check it. These are real searches, recorded on the eighth of October, and replayed here.

lines.text: The verdict: this claim does not hold. Eleven sellers list this model; two store rows that name a different model, or no model, are left out.
One store sells it for ₹280 less, so it is not the lowest price.
lines.say: One store sells it for two hundred and eighty rupees less, so it is not the lowest price.

lines.text: And the 45% off? Against the median seller price, there is no saving at all.
lines.say: And the forty five percent off? Against the median seller price, there is no saving at all.

lines.text: Only one seller charges the claimed MRP, so it is flagged as not confirmed, rather than failed.
lines.say: Only one seller charges the claimed M R P, so it is flagged as not confirmed, rather than failed.

lines.text: Here is every seller's price, with the claim and the median marked.
Every number links to its listing, and the receipt shows each SerpApi search ID and fetch time, with the raw JSON one click away.
lines.say: Every number links to its listing, and the receipt shows each Serp A P I search I D and fetch time, with the raw Jason one click away.

lines.text: A second claim: 25% off a steam iron. The deal is real, but the saving against the market is 7.3%. Overstated.
lines.say: A second claim: twenty five percent off a steam iron. The deal is real, but the saving against the market is seven point three percent. Overstated.

lines.text: And when a claim is honest, it says so. No seller undercuts this pressure cooker set's lowest-price claim.
lines.say: And when a claim is honest, it says so. No seller undercuts this pressure cooker set's lowest price claim.

lines.text: A cache and a hard cap of 150 searches protect the credits; building this used 25 of the free plan's 250 monthly searches. Every result is labelled live, cached or recorded.
lines.say: A cache, and a hard cap of a hundred and fifty searches, protect the credits. Building this used twenty five of the free plan's two hundred and fifty monthly searches. Every result is labelled live, cached, or recorded.

lines.text: Price-Claim Checker: open source, MIT licensed, built with AI assistance.
lines.say: Price-Claim Checker. Open source, M I T licensed, built with AI assistance.
